scene.name: Life as an adventurer
scene.goal: Take jobs, climb the ranks and survive Adolion.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The wolves have camped outside the gothic fortress on the kingdom's edge for weeks, hundreds of them, howling at the walls every night.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Their alpha, the bearded one, wants the lady of the castle dead. Why do they hate her so much if she fled her own father?"

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The textile merchants' mansion is spotless and the bread on the table is still warm, though the whole family was buried a year ago.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Something is calling to me from beneath the cellar floor. The father's body was never found, was it?"

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: In the great temple of the God of Life, the head priest blesses the crowd with an oily smile. The young blonde nun beside you shivers.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Sister, you said the clergy started changing the day he arrived. What is he really?"

transcript.speaker: Narrador
transcript.text: Una ladrona pelirroja con botas altas te arranca la bolsa del cinturón y corre hacia los callejones.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "¿Es de esa banda de rateros de la capital, la que apenas tiene diez miembros?"

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The ship docks under cherry blossoms on the far eastern continent. Monks leap across the rooftops, powered by their inner energy.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "I want to enroll at the academy in the capital, the one that teaches you to absorb the strength of the foes you defeat."

transcript.speaker: Narrador
transcript.text: Bajáis a la ciudad de edificios púrpura bajo la tierra, donde las elfas de piel oscura gobiernan y los esclavos cargan piedras.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "¿A qué diosa rezan aquí? He oído que es la señora del engaño y la venganza."
